members.name: Dr. Chadi Helwe
members.bio: Dr. Chadi Helwe is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Mathematics at the Lebanese American University. His primary research interest lies in Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a focus on improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). Through his doctoral and postdoctoral work at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, INRIA (CEDAR team), and KAUST, he has assessed the limitations of current models in logical reasoning, fallacy detection, and belief revision, while developing benchmarks and tools to evaluate and improve their reasoning performance. Additionally, his research extends to Arabic NLP, studying biases in LLMs and AI applications in healthcare.

members.name: Jason Greich
members.bio: Jason Greich is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics with a specialization in Data Science. His research interests lie in Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a current focus on large language models (LLMs). As part of the research team, he is contributing to the development of a bias detection library for LLMs, aimed at providing systematic evaluation tooling across a wide range of bias types and detection methodologies. He looks forward to expanding his research contributions and exploring new directions within NLP and AI as he continues to grow in the field.

members.name: Nancy Kalmiche
members.bio: Nancy Kalmiche is a Master's student in Data Science with a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, specializing in Data Science. Her research interests focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs), and she is part of the research team developing a bias detection library designed to systematically evaluate different types of bias in LLMs using a range of detection methodologies.

members.name: Elissa El Haber
members.bio: Elissa El Haber is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology with an emphasis in Artificial Intelligence, with research interests in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence. She previously worked on a research project involving EEG data analysis and is currently serving as a Research Assistant. As part of a research team, she contributes to the development of a library for detecting bias in large language models (LLMs), aimed at enabling systematic evaluation across different bias types and detection approaches.

members.name: Marc Otayek
members.bio: Marc Otayek is a recent graduate of the Lebanese American University, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. His research interests lie in Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a current focus on large language models (LLMs) and their reasoning capabilities. As part of the research team, he is contributing to the development of a benchmark for evaluating and analyzing the reasoning behavior of LLMs in Arabic, an area that remains largely underexplored relative to English-language NLP.

members.name: Maya Halabi
members.bio: Maya Halabi is a Master's student in Computer Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Her research interests include Artificial Intelligence (AI), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs). As part of the research team, she contributes to the development of a benchmark for fallacy detection in Arabic. She looks forward to expanding her research contributions and exploring new directions in NLP and AI as she continues to grow in the field.

members.name: Selim Ellieh
members.bio: Selim Ellieh is a Master's student in Computer Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. His research interests lie in Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a current focus on large language models (LLMs). Coming from a software engineering background with hands-on industry experience, he brings strong development skills to the research team. He looks forward to expanding his research contributions and exploring new directions within NLP and AI as he continues to grow in the field.

members.name: Mia AlFakhry
members.bio: Mia AlFakhry is a Master's student in Data Science at the Lebanese American University, holding a Bachelor's degree in Bioinformatics with a minor in Data Analytics, from which she graduated with distinction. Her research interests include data science, machine learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and bioinformatics, with a focus on applying computational methods to real-world research problems. She is particularly interested in working with complex datasets, developing data-driven solutions, and exploring the applications of AI across different research domains.

members.name: Elias Neemtallah
members.bio: Elias Neemtallah is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. He has professional experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), large language models (LLMs), and cloud-based AI technologies, including Microsoft Azure. His interests include AI, machine learning, data science, and the development of intelligent cloud-based solutions.

members.name: Manal Amine
members.bio: Manal Amine is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Her research interests lie at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, large language models (LLMs), and Computer Vision. She is particularly interested in understanding how AI models can be developed, evaluated, and applied to real-world problems, with an emphasis on both their capabilities and limitations.

members.name: Peter Saba
members.bio: Peter Saba is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Bioinformatics from the Lebanese American University. He works primarily with genomics data and has recently moved into the realm of large language models (LLMs) with Dr. Helwe. With LLMs increasingly being used for prediction tasks amid the rise of tabular in-context models, he aims to be at the forefront by applying these models to novel biological prediction tasks. He is currently assessing the performance of TabICLv2 on detecting cryptic sites in macromolecules.

members.name: George Levonian
members.bio: George Levonian is a Master's student in Data Science, who graduated with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science. His research interests include topics related to Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP) with niche languages and finding edge cases of an LLM's safety protocols.

members.name: Jad Antoun
members.bio: Jad Antoun is a Master's student in Data Science at the Lebanese American University, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. His research interests lie in Agentic AI, Arabic Natural Language Processing (NLP), On-Device AI, and AI Safety and Alignment. He previously worked on research projects involving on-device sign language recognition and reinforcement learning. He also works as a software engineer, with experience in building backend systems and mobile applications for the fintech industry.

members.name: Elie Shakkour
members.bio: Elie Shakkour is a Master's student in Data Science, holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science with distinction. His interests lie in developing technology that addresses community needs and supports mental health. He is motivated by the potential of data science and software development to turn ideas into practical solutions that improve people's lives. As he continues his studies, he aims to deepen his research skills and contribute to projects with meaningful social impact.

members.name: Reine Nassour
members.bio: Reine Nassour is an MSc candidate in Applied Artificial Intelligence at the Lebanese American University, with research interests in medical imaging, computer vision, and explainable AI. The proposed thesis explores how thyroid ultrasound images and clinical data can be combined to support the classification of thyroid nodules as benign or malignant.
